title: haben und die Verneinung: kein oder nicht
summary: The verb haben (to have) and the two ways to say no: kein for nouns, nicht for everything else

blocks.title: haben — to have
blocks.body: *haben* is your second everyday verb. **ich habe, du hast, er/sie/es hat, wir haben, ihr habt, sie/Sie haben.** German also uses *haben* for states English says with "to be": *Hunger haben* (to be hungry), *Durst haben* (thirsty), *Zeit haben* (to have time).

blocks.title: Saying no to a noun: kein
blocks.body: To say you **don't have** a thing, don't use *nicht* — use **kein**. It replaces *ein* and takes matching endings: **keinen** (masculine), **keine** (feminine), **kein** (neuter or no article). *Ich habe keinen Hund* (no dog), *keine Zeit* (no time), *kein Auto* (no car).
blocks.callout: Rule of thumb: if you'd use *ein* or no article at all, negate with *kein*.

blocks.title: Saying no to everything else: nicht
blocks.body: For verbs, adjectives, and specific "the"-nouns, use **nicht**. It usually sits **late**, but jumps **in front of** a predicate adjective or a place: *Ich bin nicht müde* (not tired), *Das ist nicht gut* (not good), *Ich komme heute nicht* (I'm not coming today).
blocks.callout: *kein* negates a noun; *nicht* negates the idea.

pairs.note: Noun with no specific article → kein. Verb or adjective → nicht.

blocks.prompt: How do you say 'I'm not hungry'?
blocks.explain: *Hunger* is a noun you "have", so negate it with *kein* → *keinen Hunger*. Never *nicht Hunger*.

blocks.prompt: Make it negative: 'Ich habe Zeit.' → I have no time.
blocks.explain: *Ich habe keine Zeit* — feminine noun, so *keine*.

blocks.scene: Café with Jonas. He's hungry; you're not — yet.

lines.speaker: Jonas
lines.nl: Ich habe Hunger. Hast du auch Hunger?
lines.en: I'm hungry. Are you hungry too?

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Nein, ich habe keinen Hunger. Aber ich habe Durst.
lines.en: No, I'm not hungry. But I'm thirsty.
lines.spotlight: *keinen Hunger* — negate the noun with kein, not nicht.

lines.speaker: Jonas
lines.nl: Okay. Hast du Zeit für einen Kaffee?
lines.en: Okay. Do you have time for a coffee?

lines.speaker: Jonas
lines.nl: Kein Problem. Ein Kaffee ist schnell.
lines.en: No problem. A coffee is quick.

questions.q: How does Jonas react when you only have a little time?

blocks.prompt: What do you have and not have right now? Write two things you have (Zeit? Hunger? Durst?) and one you don't — using kein once and nicht once.
